memories.content: Kofi has applied to a fellowship and needs a letter from his second referee. He knows the portal deadline is 36 hours from now. He has asked the referee to upload the letter but does not know if she has done so yet.

The fellowship portal has a hard deadline 36 hours from the simulation start time (2026-09-15T09:00:00+00:00). Referees can upload letters through the portal. Kofi cannot upload the letter himself; only the referee can do so.
